parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(name || ' ' || last_name), ''), full_name, 'Técnico de TI') as tech_name, SPLIT_PART(TRIM(name), ' ', 1) as first_name FROM bitrix_users_cache WHERE user_id = {{ $json.user_id }};

UPDATE ticket_bot_sessions SET status = CASE WHEN '{{ $('Merge_Context').first().json.action }}' = 'accept' THEN 'HUMAN_TAKEOVER' ELSE 'IN_QUEUE' END, ai_state = 'AI_PAUSED', last_interaction_at = NOW() WHERE deal_id = {{ $('Merge_Context').first().json.deal_id }};

INSERT INTO ticket_csat_ratings (deal_id, requester_user_id, rating, feedback_text, created_at) VALUES ({{ $json.deal_id }}, COALESCE((SELECT requester_user_id FROM ticket_bot_sessions WHERE deal_id = {{ $json.deal_id }}), 32598), {{ $json.rating }}, 'Avaliação 1-clique via chat', NOW()) RETURNING id;
